purpose: Determine whether the current public-data boundary is sufficient to open a scientifically defensible calibration/validation cycle for the bank-credit response mechanism without conflating loan demand, credit supply, prudential state variables or sector composition.
current_registry_form: gCredit = alpha + beta_y*gActivity - beta_r*real_lending_rate - beta_npl*NPL + beta_cap*capital_buffer

official_source_evidence.source: Monthly Bulletin, January 2025, Table 11.1 Key prudential indicators
findings: Total capital ratio is published for Romanian legal-entity credit institutions; the current prudential reporting basis starts in June 2014 under Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) No 680/2014 and continues under Regulation (EU) 2021/451 from June 2021.
The NPL ratio is published under the EBA/CRR non-performing-exposure definition.

The January 2025 bulletin contains monthly NPL observations and quarterly total-capital-ratio observations for 2024, demonstrating an exact tabular source path rather than a need for chart digitisation.
The survey is conducted quarterly and covers the top 10 banks, accounting for approximately 80 percent of the loan stock.
The questionnaire treats non-financial corporations and households separately.
It reports realised credit standards and loan demand as distinct net-percentage concepts, alongside credit terms/conditions and risk assessments.

official_source_evidence.source: 2014 presentation on the EBA non-performing-exposure indicator
findings: The harmonised EBA non-performing-exposure indicator was specified for quarterly reporting with first reference date 30 September 2014.
This establishes a methodological lower-bound/review point for a long NPL history; earlier NPL concepts must not be concatenated silently.

existing_rmd_credit_evidence.interpretation: RMD already retains sector-specific monthly stock and financial-transaction components for NFCs and households/NPISH. The aggregate credit reference mode is their exact same-month sum, so no new synthetic sector split is needed.

scientific_boundary_decisions.reason: The current aggregate reduced form mixes credit demand and credit supply. NPL and capital ratios are endogenous prudential state variables and cannot by themselves identify a bank-supply channel.
scientific_boundary_decisions.BLS_credit_standards_role: Direct survey proxy for changes in bank lending standards/supply conditions; not automatically a causal instrument.
scientific_boundary_decisions.BLS_loan_demand_role: Direct survey proxy for reported loan-demand change; keep separate from supply standards.
scientific_boundary_decisions.NPL_role: Prudential/credit-risk state control, not an exogenous credit-supply shock.
scientific_boundary_decisions.total_capital_ratio_role: Banking-system prudential state control, not an exogenous supply shock and not a substitute for a capital-buffer shock.

required_before_any_estimation: Enumerate and retain the exact official BNR BLS spreadsheet rounds needed for the chosen history; every included file requires its original URL, bytes/hash, survey round and realised-versus-expected column semantics.
Exact retained quarterly realised BNR Bank Lending Survey credit-standard series for NFCs and households, with source provenance.
Exact retained quarterly realised BNR Bank Lending Survey loan-demand series for NFCs and households, with source provenance.
Exact retained harmonised NPL-ratio history with methodological break metadata; no silent concatenation of pre-EBA definitions.

Resolve the prudential-control boundary prospectively: retain a definitionally matched quarterly NPL series and freeze whether the capital state is total capital ratio or CET1 before any model fit. Annual or mismatched-population substitutes are not admissible.
Exact retained total-capital-ratio history on the CRR supervisory-reporting boundary, with the 2021 reporting-regulation transition recorded.
Explicit mapping of lending-rate and activity observables to the NFC and household credit components.
A preregistered structural-selection and untouched holdout design written only after the source series above are frozen.
prohibited_shortcuts: Use NPL or capital ratio as if either were a clean exogenous bank-supply instrument.
Infer loan demand from credit growth alone.
Average NFC and household BLS net percentages into a synthetic aggregate without a separately justified weighting contract.
Digitise historical BLS/NPL/capital charts when exact tables or official spreadsheets are unavailable.
Difference credit stocks to manufacture credit flows.
Open a holdout or choose lags after inspecting evaluation outcomes.
source_materialisation_gate.pass_effect: Passing source materialisation authorises a separately preregistered sector-specific candidate-selection cycle only. It does not activate the bank-credit balance-sheet loop or establish causal identification.
source_materialisation_gate.fail_effect: Keep aggregate_bank_credit_response as CANDIDATE with no central feedback activation and do not estimate the current aggregate equation.

preferred_future_candidate_boundary.unit_of_analysis: sector-specific, at minimum NFC and household/NPISH credit paths
preferred_future_candidate_boundary.target_priority: ECB BSI financial transactions and/or stock growth kept definitionally distinct
preferred_future_candidate_boundary.supply_demand_separation: Use realised BLS credit standards and realised BLS loan demand as separate observables; test whether they add out-of-sample information beyond persistence/activity/rate baselines.
preferred_future_candidate_boundary.causal_claim: Not permitted from predictive selection alone.
preferred_future_candidate_boundary.central_feedback_activation: Not permitted from source feasibility or predictive selection alone.

bls_machine_readable_source_catalog.provider_access_observation: GitHub Actions successfully retrieved seven exact official BNR BLS workbooks from 2023-2025 as valid OLE2 XLS files; the prior web-layer Request Rejected behavior was an access-path limitation, not missing files.
bls_machine_readable_source_catalog.next_required_step: Recover only the exact official 2025-Q2 workbook endpoint/bytes under the frozen recovery chain if an independent official clue appears. Do not infer archive URLs or substitute publication-rounded values. Separately materialise a population-matched BNR prudential history before any credit-response structural-selection contract.

may_2025_xlsx_bridge.interpretation: The XLSX round demonstrates deterministic supply/demand semantics and sector separation but contains only one survey round. It is not a historical BLS time series.
may_2025_xlsx_bridge.dsti_limit: P0303/P1103 are lending-term change questions about maximum debt-service-to-income, not levels of borrower DSTI.

cet1_quarterly_domestic_banks.concept: Common equity Tier 1 (CET1) ratio, domestic banks, Romania, quarterly
cet1_quarterly_domestic_banks.confirmed_latest_example: 2025-Q3 = 20.2275 percent (provisional in the indexed ECB page)
cet1_quarterly_domestic_banks.semantic_limit: CET1 ratio is not the same variable as the BNR total capital ratio currently named in the source gate. It may not silently replace that variable.

npl_annual_broad_boundary.concept: Gross non-performing loans-to-gross loans ratio, domestic banks plus foreign subsidiaries/branches, FINREP reporters, Romania, annual
npl_annual_broad_boundary.confirmed_latest_example: 2024 = 2.6254 percent (provisional in the indexed ECB page)
npl_annual_broad_boundary.semantic_limit: Annual frequency and the 67-sector population do not match the desired quarterly BNR system-state control; no interpolation or repeated-quarter use is permitted.

cbd2_quarterly_npl_family.evidence: ECB Data Portal explicitly lists Romania among quarterly domestic-bank FINREP I3632 NPL-ratio series.

npl_quarterly_domestic_banks.concept: Gross non-performing loans and advances as percent of total gross loans and advances, domestic banks, FINREP reporters, Romania, quarterly
npl_quarterly_domestic_banks.coverage: 2014-Q4 onward in the indexed ECB Data Portal
npl_quarterly_domestic_banks.confirmed_latest_example: 2025-Q3 = 3.7504 percent in the indexed ECB dataset page
npl_quarterly_domestic_banks.semantic_limit: Domestic banks and FINREP reporters; population/reporting-framework compatibility with BNR system-wide indicators must be documented before use.

solvency_ratio_candidate.concept: Solvency ratio [%], domestic banks, Romania, quarterly
solvency_ratio_candidate.coverage: 2014-Q4 to 2026-Q1 in the retained 2026-09-19 source vintage
solvency_ratio_candidate.role: Definitionally closer prudential capital-state candidate than CET1, subject to explicit population/consolidation bridge to the BNR total-capital-ratio boundary.
solvency_ratio_candidate.semantic_limit: The CBD2 domestic-bank/full-sample boundary is not numerically identical to the BNR Romanian-legal-entity population; observed differences may not be balanced away or ignored.

decision_rules: Do not choose CET1 versus total capital ratio after observing predictive fit.
Do not forward-fill an annual NPL ratio into quarterly observations.
Do not mix domestic-bank-only and domestic-plus-foreign-branch populations without an explicit boundary bridge.
Any future switch from total capital ratio to CET1 requires a preregistered source/variable contract before model outcomes are inspected.
Prefer a confirmed quarterly Romania solvency-ratio series over substituting CET1 only if its exact CBD2 tuple, coverage and population are retained before model fit.

population_boundary_decision.basis: BNR Romanian-legal-entity-bank population is not the same control/consolidation population as CBD2 sector 11 domestic banking groups and stand-alone banks.
population_boundary_decision.future_preferred_source: Exact BNR-population statistical-table history or another officially documented matched population.

external_prudential_source_screening.next_admissible_source_task: No active matched-prudential discovery task remains under the current public surface. Reopen only on new official BNR link/catalog/export/population-bridge evidence; do not repeat the same discovery probes or infer endpoints.

prudential_coverage_diagnostic.coverage: All three exact Romania CBD2 series contain 46 quarterly observations from 2014-Q4 through 2026-Q1.
prudential_coverage_diagnostic.conclusion: Quarterly CBD2 NPL/solvency/CET1 availability is confirmed, but official population definitions reject direct substitution for the BNR Romanian-legal-entity-bank anchor. The next defensible source path is exact BNR-population table materialisation or a genuinely matched official source.
